bills.description: What it settles of each bill.

date.description: The day the money left the account.

fx_rate.description: For bills in another currency paid from an account in that currency: base currency per one unit, as on the bank's advice. Left out, the cascade's rate for the date (ENG-40).

money_account_id.description: The bank, card or wallet account it left: an active money account in the bills' currency or in the base currency.

examples: Paid in two parts, as agreed

paid.description: For bills in another currency paid from a base-currency account: what the account paid, in the base currency, as the statement shows it; the payment settles at the rate it implies. Required then, and only then (LEDGER-27).

supplier_id.description: The supplier paid; left out, the first bill's supplier. Every bill is the supplier's.

unapplied.description: What it paid beyond the bills, in their currency: kept as a credit with the supplier (FR-AR-18). Left out, nothing.
